created_by.description: The Project user who created this category. Present only when a creator is recorded.

id.description: Login Information (user) identifier of the creator.

login.description: Email address the creator signs in with.

name.description: Full display name of the creator.

project_id.description: Identifier of the Project the Meeting belongs to. Must reference an existing Project the caller can access.

meeting_id.description: Identifier of the Meeting the new category will be added to.

meeting_category.description: Attributes for the meeting category to create or update.

position.description: Zero-based sort order for the category within the Meeting. When omitted on create, the category is appended after existing categories.

title.description: Display name for the category, shown as a section heading for its topics.
